title: Young Mahuika: The Burnt Wing
author: Astra_Calico
selftext:
To be honest, the code for the game I’m currently developing was written by an AI.   
Everything else is my own work—or, in some cases, includes elements from other sources used in compliance with copyright permissions. This is just the beginning; I’ve only been working on this project for about a month. It’s my very first project, and I had no prior knowledge of coding, but the AI ​​helped me out. Now, I’m gradually learning to code myself, and I’m even able to make adjustments or corrections here and there.   
I’m not proud of the fact that I started; I’m proud that I didn’t give up. I believe in my own potential, and I believe that games should still have a soul. I want to pour my entire soul into this game—because, in this world, there is nothing more desirable than bringing back the good old days.
